steps.title: Add DPBS to plate 1 columns 1‑7
steps.instruction: Transfer 180 µL DPBS into columns 1‑7 of destination plate 1.

steps.title: Add DPBS to plate 1 column 8
steps.instruction: Transfer 160 µL DPBS into column 8 of destination plate 1.

steps.title: Add and mix test article
steps.instruction: Transfer 20 µL Test Article into column 1 of destination plate 1 and mix 20 times.

steps.title: Serial dilution across columns 1‑7
steps.instruction: Perform serial dilutions from column 1 through column 7 of destination plate 1 by transferring 20 µL from the previous column to the next, mixing 20 times after each transfer, using a new tip for each column transfer.

steps.title: Transfer and mix from column 6 to 8
steps.instruction: Transfer 40 µL from column 6 of destination plate 1 to column 8 of the same plate and mix 20 times.

steps.title: Add master mix to plate 2
steps.instruction: Transfer 20 µL master mix into columns 1‑5 of destination plate 2.

steps.title: Transfer sample aliquots to plate 2
steps.instruction: Transfer 5 µL from column 6 of destination plate 1 to column 1 of destination plate 2; transfer 5 µL from column 7 of destination plate 1 to column 2 of destination plate 2; transfer 5 µL from column 8 of destination plate 1 to column 3 of destination plate 2. Use a new tip for each transfer.

steps.title: Add water to plate 2 columns 4‑5
steps.instruction: Transfer 5 µL water to columns 4‑5 of destination plate 2, using a new tip for each transfer.
